messages.author: a29b76a7fee2ac43
messages.subject: Visualisation for multidimensional item characteristics
parts:
Hi all,

I am a newbie who just joined the group. I am planning to use mirt to perform analysis on multivariate survey data and would like to learn more about the compensatory and non-compensatory multidimensional models. A quick question, is there any function in the mirt package that allows me to plot a multidimensional model (with say more than 10 factors/abilities) but restrict the plot to one 1-2 thetas at a time? Basically, I just want to preview the ICC on certain items visually.

Or alternatively, what is the best way to visualise multidimensional item characteristics?

Thanks!

p.s. Pardon my ignorance and the terminology used, I am still learning about this fascinating framework and all its functions.

Regards,
Zhao

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Visualisation for multidimensional item characteristics
parts:
If you have simpler structures various plotting functions support a drop.zeros = TRUE input, which will try and plot any functions that can ignore the complete dimensionality of the model by removing factors that do not correlate with the item (i.e., have 0 slopes/loadings). That may be helpful, but of course only works under special setups. HTH.

Phil
